summary.text: Colin Savage is the Democratic candidate for the West Virginia House of Delegates, District 84, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he is passionate about education policy, criminal justice reform and a people-centered economy.

paragraphs.text: Savage said in the survey that West Virginians deserve a more affordable state, citing the price of groceries, the cost of living and the minimum wage.

He also said schools should receive better funding and resources, that Republicans and Democrats should work together in the House of Delegates, and that the state should support law enforcement and first responders.
He said marijuana should be decriminalized and ideally made legal.
